title: Homie: listing to reel in four clicks

take: pixel burst into logo and glowing wordmark write-on to open
zoomed, tilted shots of the real interface instead of full screens
a cartoon hand cursor clicks each step
mostly hard cuts with the motion inside each shot
short how-to steps, one action per shot
shorter steps than the reference's 6.5 s shots, paced for a Reel; drums enter on the first app shot

scenes.notes: Look: near-black ground #0d0f0c with a soft sage (#a3c98b) glow, one accent sage, kit display face. 24 s, 9:16, no voice, original 120 BPM music plus Kenney UI sounds from brag. Visual thread: the real Homie app, seen through a tilted camera that pushes into the next control, with one hand cursor carried through every step. Open: pixel squares burst and gather into the H mark, wordmark writes on with a glow.
A half-second pixel glitch: the logo breaks into squares that resolve into the app screen, as the reference's glitch frames do.
Real sidebar, tilted and zoomed. The hand clicks My listings, then My videos, then Explore; the active pill follows each click.
Real Explore grid; camera pushes in while the hand travels to the Spin Tour card and clicks.
Real Spin Tour detail; camera slides down to the controls, the hand clicks Choose listing.
Real listing picker; the hand clicks 1428 Maple Crest Dr.
Real Create button, close up; the hand presses it. A short rest in the music before the result.
The real Spin Tour film plays in a rounded phone card that lands on a low hit.
End card: the mark and wordmark, one line, the address in sage.
